patch.title: Deep Lake Solar: 150 MW Siting Application in Nicholas and Clay Counties
patch.description: West Virginia’s regulator records Deep Lake Energy Center’s application for a 150 MW solar generating facility on approximately 1,521 acres in Nicholas and Clay counties.
patch.longFormSummary: • The regulator’s June 2024 order establishes the application and land scope. It does not establish construction commencement, commercial operation or the former USD 386 million budget.
patch.dateConfidenceReasoning: The cited project source establishes 2024-03-25. Preserve the stated precision; a year, month or quarter anchor is not an announced exact opening day.
patch.address: Nicholas and Clay counties, West Virginia, United States

addReferences.title: Opened project owner / authority project evidence

power.note: Applied-for solar generating capacity, not verified operating output.

patch.title: Tallgrass Solar, Ellis County: 175 MW Proposed Interconnection Capacity
patch.description: Ellis County’s Tallgrass Solar application specifies 175 MWac at the point of interconnection and a proposed investment of approximately USD 275 million or more.
patch.longFormSummary: • The permitting layout is marked for development and not for construction or bidding. The county documents identify Tallgrass Development LLC and ibV Energy Partners; they do not prove a completed plant or establish an exact opening day.
patch.dateConfidenceReasoning: The cited project source establishes 2026-01-13. Preserve the stated precision; a year, month or quarter anchor is not an announced exact opening day.
